project_settings_modal.worktrees_help: Each worktree is a separate working tree on disk on its own branch. Use them to run multiple parallel sessions on the same project without stepping on each other.

welcome.title: Welcome to Oxyris
welcome.tagline: A desktop coding agent for Windows and WSL with parallel Claude sessions.
welcome.check_claude_missing_detail: Run `claude auth login` in any environment you plan to use, then click Refresh in Settings.
welcome.next_body: Pick a folder on Windows or inside a WSL distro. Each project can host multiple parallel sessions on separate git worktrees.
welcome.shortcut_hint: Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+N opens this anywhere in the app. Esc interrupts the current turn.
